function @damp($input:number, $const1:number, $const2:number) : number
	return $input * $const1 / (1 + (sqrt(input_number("linv main", 0)^2+input_number("linv main", 1)^2+input_number("linv main", 2)^2) / ($const2*100))^2)
	
function @squarein($input:number) : number
	return sign($input) * $input * $input

function @p($_setpoint:number, $_processvalue:number, $_kp:number) : number
	var $_output = $_kp *($_setpoint - $_processvalue)
	return $_output
	
function @pd1($setpoint:number, $processvalue:number, $kp:number, $kd:number, $prev:number) : number
	var $output = $kp *($setpoint - $processvalue) + $kd * ($processvalue - $prev)/delta_time
	$prev = $processvalue
	return $output

function @pd2($setpoint:number, $processvalue:number, $kp:number, $kd:number, $prev:number) : number
	var $output = $kp *($setpoint - $processvalue) + $kd * ($processvalue - $prev)/delta_time
	$prev = $processvalue
	return $output
function @pd3($setpoint:number, $processvalue:number, $kp:number, $kd:number, $prev:number) : number
	var $output = $kp *($setpoint - $processvalue) + $kd * ($processvalue - $prev)/delta_time
	$prev = $processvalue
	return $output
function @pd4($setpoint:number, $processvalue:number, $kp:number, $kd:number, $prev:number) : number
	var $output = $kp *($setpoint - $processvalue) + $kd * ($processvalue - $prev)/delta_time
	$prev = $processvalue
	return $output
	
function @abs($input:number, $rotSpd:number, $wheelSpd:number):number
	var $output = 0
	
	if $input > 0 
		if abs($rotSpd < 1) && abs($wheelSpd) > 0
		else
			$output = 1
			
	return $output

function @tractionCtrl($input:number, $rotSpd:number, $wheelSpd:number):number
	var $output = $input
	
	$rotSpd = $rotSpd * pi ;velocity = (rot/sec)* 2 * pi * (0.5m)
	if abs($input) > 0
		$output += clamp(@p(0,$rotSpd-$wheelSpd,0.025),-1,1)
			
	return $output

function @gearBox($rotSpd:number, $wheelSpd:number):number
	var $output = 0
	
	$rotSpd = $rotSpd * pi ;velocity = (rot/sec)* 2 * pi * (0.5m)
	$output += clamp(1-@p(0,$rotSpd-$wheelSpd,0.1),-1,1)
			
	return $output

function @angle($vx:number, $vy:number, $vz:number):number
	if $vz == 0
		$vz = 0.00001
	var $angle = atan($vx/$vz) * 180/pi
	;print($angle)
	
	return $angle
